responsibility: Constructs the backend tree types and layout metadata required by gfortran lowering. It initializes the canonical scalar kinds, descriptor and coarray record types, interoperable C kinds, and helper structures for array descriptors and CAF references, and it exposes the type builders that all trans-* files use when materializing Fortran entities in the backend.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete construction and initialization of backend type nodes and layouts: scalar kind tables, descriptor/coarray record layouts, dtype and CAF helper types, interoperable C kind data, and related type builders. The header merely publishes those type nodes, flags, and builder/query APIs for the rest of the lowering code.
